title: Case 024: Reason for the Card Restriction
initial_request: Rowan wants to know why their H&V card became temporarily unavailable after it was declined during a grocery purchase, and whether the restriction has been lifted.
overview: Rowan contacted H&V through secure chat after seeing the card-unavailable status in the secure portal. The agent checked the permitted explanation and disclosure limit in the card journal. H&V confirmed that the permitted category was a temporary security-related restriction; no lifting of the restriction was confirmed.

next_action.summary: Check the card journal for the permitted restriction category and the limit on what can be disclosed.

outcome: H&V provided the permitted category: a temporary security-related restriction. The restriction's exact basis was not shown, and no release or timing was promised.

events.body: Status: Your card is temporarily unavailable. This status does not show the reason.
I’m the cardholder and my card was declined while I was paying for groceries. Please tell me the category of the restriction and whether it has been lifted.
I’m checking the permitted category for this restriction and the limit on what I may disclose to Rowan.
Permitted category: temporary security-related restriction. Exact basis is not shown. Do not provide operational detail or confirm that the restriction will be lifted.

I can confirm that your card has a temporary security-related restriction. I can’t provide further operational detail, and this confirmation does not mean the restriction has been lifted or say when it may be.
